# Videezy

> > Videezy is a royalty-free stock video platform offering 100,000+ free downloadable video clips spanning nature footage, motion graphics, abstract backgrounds, and 4K content for creative projects.

Videezy provides creative commons and royalty-free video footage organized by themes ranging from nature landscapes (Mount Fuji, Thailand beaches) to abstract motion backgrounds compatible with After Effects. The platform serves filmmakers, content creators, and designers seeking high-quality stock video assets including 4K footage, aerial drone shots, and visual effects elements.

## Key Topics

- Stock video footage
- Royalty-free videos
- 4K video downloads
- Nature footage
- Motion graphics
- Abstract backgrounds
- After Effects templates
- Video library
- Creative commons clips
- Visual effects
- Aerial drone footage
- Motion backgrounds
- Thailand locations
- Outdoor scenes
- Free video downloads
